title: pvCleanCellstoGrid
body:
## pvCleanCellstoGrid

Removes duplicate cells (cells using the same set of points) from an unstructured grid and repairs cells that reference the same point more than once; the output is an unstructured grid. Use it after merging meshes or importing data with repeated elements. It assumes duplicate points were merged already, so run pvCleantoGrid first.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Cells that are geometrically identical but use different (unmerged) point IDs are not detected as duplicates.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `CleanCellstoGrid`. Identity: `filters/CleanUnstructuredGridCells`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Clean Cells to Grid filter. Accepted data: unstructured grids (vtkUnstructuredGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkUnstructuredGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

```json

  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
